name: Dack Fayden
description: A human mage from Drakeston on Fiora who became a planeswalker and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Attendees argue about surrender or hiding, and Vorel blames planeswalkers while the archer and Samut insist Bolas is never sated.
timeline.quote: There is literally nothing left of my world, Skalla, thanks to him.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden overhears and backs the plan, and Chandra sets off with Rai, Nissa and guildmembers.
timeline.quote: They set off for New Prahv.

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

timeline.summary: An Eternal harvests Dack Fayden's Spark once the Sun is reactivated, killing him.
timeline.quote: As Dack's Spark was ripped from him

timeline.summary: Dack and Marsh, adept young mages lacking judgment, pick a fight with brutes one night and Marsh is killed.
timeline.quote: One night, their genius got the best of them and they picked a fight with brutes, resulting in the death of Marsh.

timeline.summary: Dack's spark ignites at Marsh's death and he becomes a planeswalker and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: In that moment, Dack’s spark ignited and he became a Planeswalker—and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.

pages_say.description: A psychometrist thief and planeswalker whom Rat has been studying and who attempts to touch Kiora's bident.
A thief planeswalker who magnetizes the Eternals' lazotep and is killed when an Eternal harvests his Spark.
A human mage from Drakeston on Fiora who became a planeswalker and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.
